_provenance.note: Observations were recorded against the version above; re-verify against the current spec snapshot before relying on them.

spec_vs_reality_notes: Search endpoint (GET /api/v1/market-data/search): the fields= query param is marked required in spec but is NOT enforced — verified empirically (request without it returns 200)

Search default response (no fields=) returns ~50+ analytic / market-cap fields NOT described in the Instrument schema below — many with hyphenated names like peRatio-TTM-System-Avg that cannot be Rust struct field names without #[serde(rename = ...)]
Search default response includes a system-aggregate pseudo-instrument with negative instrumentId (-100000) containing crypto-market-wide stats (Bitcoin dominance, etc.) — filter out negative IDs
Standard fields like symbol, displayname, exchangeID, instrumentType return null UNLESS explicitly listed in fields=
Default pageSize is 20; totalItems can be ~11k+ — always paginate or filter narrowly
Live rates: rate items use instrumentID (CAPITAL ID) — different casing than instrumentId in search response. Need #[serde(rename = "instrumentID")] in Rust
Live rates: spec marks several fields obsolete (unitMargin*, *Discounted) — skip modeling them
Live rates: prices are float in spec — use rust_decimal::Decimal in production code, never f32/f64 for money
MarketAssetType and MarketEventTag are integer-encoded enums with string-named variants — wire format is the integer index (NOT the string name)
Standalone Market schema is DIFFERENT from the inline market object inside WatchlistItemDto — same name, different shape

candlesResponse has nested 'candles' inside outer 'candles' (different shapes) — outer item per-instrument, inner items per-time-period. Inner items use instrumentID (capital), outer uses instrumentId (lowercase). Yes, really.

closingPricesResponse top level is a bare ARRAY (no envelope object). Outer items each carry instrumentId + officialClosingPrice + nested daily/weekly/monthly with prices that can be -1 (sentinel for 'no data')
modeling_recommendations: For symbol resolution: pass internalSymbolFull=AAPL AND fields=instrumentId,internalSymbolFull,displayname,symbol — then verify exact internalSymbolFull match per the docs
Skip search items where instrumentId < 0 (system aggregates)
Treat all Instrument fields as Option<T> — none are required by spec and reality confirms many can be null
For closing prices: handle the -1 sentinel value explicitly, ideally Option<Decimal> via custom deserializer that maps -1 -> None
_notes.consolidated_from_common: Avatar/Svg/ApplicationSource were previously in common-schema.json. Merged here because they are referenced ONLY by Market (Avatar←Market, Svg←Avatar, ApplicationSource←Market) — no other domain consumes them.

_removed_stamps.reason: Removed at the v1.355.0 refresh: upstream deleted these standalone enum components and inlined them as `type: string` enums at each use site, so there is no schema left to stamp and the declared wire format is no longer the integer index. The matching int_or_string_enum! types remain in src/types/manual.rs, unreferenced, because they also accepted the integer form -- reattach them if live responses turn out to still send integers.
